title: RFS earnings-extrapolation newsy-month signal transfer to US500 regular-cash economics
user_boundary: The repository-integrity patch and Unit 111 are closed on origin/main, and the continuous Live-derived Optimization Goal has returned to whole-map discovery. This is one serial Lab research detour created from a genuinely new source-fixed hypothesis. It may retain one information seed but grants no Optimization candidate, MT5 shortlist, fixed-candidate modification, deployment, promotion or Live authority by itself.

research_height.transfer_path: A publication-fixed aggregate monthly return predictor must survive causal source-history continuation, a balanced long/short monthly direction, exact broker bid/ask cash-session cost, chronological periods, newsy/non-newsy and long/short breadth, mechanism and drift controls, concentration limits and the latest period before one additive information seed can exist.

central_question: Does the exact Guo (2025) expanding earnings-extrapolation monthly direction produce positive and superior US500 09:30..16:00 ET regular-cash economics after doubled FPMarkets spread burden over July 2022 through July 2026, all after the author replication file ends?
economic_hypothesis: If newsy-month earnings extrapolation creates a durable aggregate return predictor rather than a historical total-return artifact, its source-fixed monthly LONG/SHORT direction should produce positive stressed regular-cash economics in P1, 2024, 2025, early 2026 and the latest June-July 2026 period; both target-month roles and both trade directions should contribute; and the primary should beat the same-beta no-target-flip mechanism control and unconditional cash-session LONG drift.

literature_anchor.title: Earnings Extrapolation and Predictable Stock Market Returns
literature_anchor.author: Hongye Guo
frozen_facts: The first month of each calendar quarter, January/April/July/October, is defined as newsy because it contains fresh aggregate earnings information.
Past newsy-month market returns predict future newsy months with the opposite sign and future non-newsy months with the same sign.
The source's real-time implementation sums the latest four newsy-month returns, subtracts its expanding-window mean and flips the sign when the target month is newsy.
The source estimates the forecast relation only on causally available expanding history and forms a portfolio weight proportional to forecast return minus the expanding return mean.
The paper reports approximately four-percent out-of-sample return-prediction R-squared and a profitable real-time aggregate-market strategy.
The author CC0 return file spans December 1925 through June 2021, so every project target from July 2022 is later than the exact replication input.
literature_anchor.translation_limit: The source uses aggregate U.S. market total returns and a month-level portfolio. This unit splices the CC0 author history to broker US500 D1 price returns after June 2021, takes only the sign of the exact paper excess weight and executes that direction separately in every regular cash session. It neither claims an exact CRSP total-return replication nor tests overnight, month-hold, financing, futures or cash-equity economics.

why_now.new_independent_source: The 2025 RFS article and its public CC0 replication package provide one exact, causal, easily executable aggregate direction after Unit 111 closed and the whole map resumed. The source fixes cause, calendar, four-newsy-month lookback, expanding demeaning, target sign flip and causal beta before any target M15 price or spread outcome opens.
why_now.program_distance: Unit 111 was Program 3 and tested only final-four/first-four official session rank with unconditional LONG. Unit 112 is Program 1 and conditions every session in an entire month on an independently published causal price signal. It does not select a surviving month, quarter, role, direction, clock or cost from Unit 111.
why_now.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one FIXED_RFS_NEWSY_MONTH_US500_CASH_SESSION_DIRECTION information seed. Only a later whole-map comparison may decide whether a separately owned Optimization campaign tests integration with the fixed development candidate.
why_now.decision_if_false: Close the complete earnings-extrapolation regular-cash transfer with no lookback, weighting, beta, threshold, target-month, direction, clock, overnight, symbol, cost, sizing or integration rescue.

whole_map_recomparison.program_1: Selected because the independent source fixes one aggregate causal price signal and one target-month sign transformation. It is not a threshold, pattern, breakout or source-free direction search.
whole_map_recomparison.program_2: No external macro, event, volatility, uncertainty or cross-asset state is introduced; only lagged aggregate market returns and a fixed calendar role enter.
whole_map_recomparison.program_3: Every eligible target session uses the already established 09:30..16:00 ET executable cash boundary. No session or neighboring clock is a candidate.
whole_map_recomparison.program_4: Every proxy trade closes at the same cash boundary. No stop, trailing, checkpoint, hold or giveback rule opens.
whole_map_recomparison.program_5: Volume stays 0.01 and paper weight magnitude is deliberately discarded. No lot, leverage, risk, allocation, cap or portfolio reconstruction opens.
whole_map_recomparison.program_7: Source parity, causal timing and coverage diagnostics protect interpretation only. They cannot choose a subgroup, reclassify failure or create a successor.
whole_map_recomparison.after_close: Return immediately to the Optimization whole map without an adjacent monthly-signal successor or reporting pause.

distinction_from_closed_work.unit_053_monthly_range_break: Unit 053 tested crossing a prior monthly high/low and closed with no direction. Unit 112 uses no range, breakout, level or intramonth trigger; direction is fixed before the target month by the paper's past-four-newsy-return formula.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_070_rc16_long_drift: Unit 070 decomposed an existing native RC16 signal against unconditional LONG drift. Unit 112 creates no RC16 treatment and explicitly uses LONG_ONLY as a control rather than an inferred candidate.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_071_server_calendar_drift: Unit 071 segmented server-calendar carry. Unit 112 uses source-defined target calendar months in America/New_York and exact official cash sessions, not server-day state.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_108_cash_close: Unit 108 used prior half-hour direction to predict the final half-hour on US30/US100. Unit 112 uses a month-lagged aggregate predictor on US500 across the entire regular cash session.
distinction_from_closed_work.unit_111_turn_of_month: Unit 111 used no price predictor and traded only PRE4/POST4 LONG. Unit 112 trades all eligible sessions in each target month LONG or SHORT from a separate RFS earnings-extrapolation mechanism; the no-flip and long-only paths are controls, not survivors from Unit 111.

premetric_corrections.fault: The first source metadata snapshot used object reserialization and emitted a depth warning.
premetric_corrections.correction: Replace it before freeze with the exact raw Dataverse API response and verify version 1.0, CC0 and fixed file IDs.

premetric_corrections.fault: The first predictor-only premetric invocation used a Series.reset_index keyword unsupported by the installed pandas version.
premetric_corrections.correction: Use the version-compatible rename_axis/reset_index form with no formula, input, period, cost or gate change.

fixed_return_splice.author_history: Use author CC0 vwretd through June 2021 inclusive.
fixed_return_splice.broker_bridge: For July 2021 onward, use last US500 D1 close of month divided by the preceding month's last D1 close minus one.
fixed_return_splice.incomplete_august_2026: Excluded from both predictor outcome history and target economics.
fixed_return_splice.causal_integrity: Every expanding beta for target t+1 uses origin rows through t-1, whose target returns are known by the end of origin t.

fixed_signal_rule.origin: For target month t+1, stand at the end of month t.
fixed_signal_rule.raw_four_newsy_sum: Arithmetic sum of the latest four newsy-month returns known at t.
fixed_signal_rule.expanding_mean: Mean of raw four-newsy sums over strictly earlier origin months only.
fixed_signal_rule.demeaned_unflipped: raw sum minus strictly prior expanding mean.
fixed_signal_rule.flipped_demeaned: Negative demeaned value when target is newsy; unchanged when target is non-newsy.
fixed_signal_rule.expanding_beta: OLS slope with intercept of realized next-month return on flipped demeaned predictor, trained only through origin t-1.
fixed_signal_rule.paper_excess_weight: expanding beta times flipped demeaned predictor.
fixed_signal_rule.primary_direction: LONG for positive paper excess weight, SHORT for negative, FLAT only for exact zero.
fixed_signal_rule.magnitude: Discarded; every active session uses exactly 0.01 lot.

fixed_controls.NO_FLIP: Use the same exact expanding beta and demeaned predictor but suppress only the target-newsy sign flip, then take sign. It is a mechanism falsifier and cannot be promoted.
fixed_controls.LONG_ONLY: Trade the same 0.01 regular-cash LONG on every eligible session. It is the drift control and cannot be promoted.
fixed_controls.opposite_primary: Not calculated, not declared and cannot rescue a failure.

fixed_trade_rule.eligible_target: Every official NYSE session from July 2022 through July 2026 with exact 09:30 and 15:45 ET M15 boundary bars and a causal monthly direction.
fixed_trade_rule.direction: The one source-fixed primary direction for that calendar month.
fixed_trade_rule.gross: Direction times entry-mid to exit-mid P/L.
fixed_trade_rule.observed: Gross less half of the entry-plus-exit spread burden, exactly equivalent to ask-to-bid LONG and bid-to-ask SHORT execution.
fixed_trade_rule.stressed: Gross less the full entry-plus-exit spread burden; binding doubled-cost measure.
fixed_trade_rule.commission_swap_financing: Zero because every position closes inside one regular cash session.
fixed_trade_rule.drawdown: Closed-balance cumulative daily path; proxy drawdown cannot prove native floating-equity DD.

premetric_feasibility.scope: Only immutable bytes/schema, author and broker predictor history, exact source formula, causal regression timing, target month/type/direction, M15 timestamps, official session identity, fixed boundary availability, periods and counts were opened.

economic_gates.density: At least 340/225/225/90/35 eligible days in P1/P2/P3/P4/P5.
economic_gates.p1: P1 primary stressed net >0, PF >=1.05, net/DD >=1.25, all three chronological splits positive, both NEWSY and NON_NEWSY positive, both LONG and SHORT contributions positive, and primary mean/day above both NO_FLIP and LONG_ONLY.
economic_gates.confirmation: P2, P3 and P4 primary stressed nets each >0; at least 5/6 NEWSY/NON_NEWSY period cells positive; primary mean/day above both controls in at least 2/3 periods.
economic_gates.prelatest: P1-P4 primary PF >=1.075, net/DD >=1.50, at least 60% positive active months, top-five positive-day share <=35%, both LONG and SHORT contributions positive, and primary mean/day above both controls.
economic_gates.drawdown: Nominal closed DD <=20.0%; practical closed DD <=21.2%, recorded separately.
economic_gates.latest: P5 stressed net >=0 nominally; practical floor permits reversal no worse than one quarter of positive prelatest mean/day times latest eligible days.
economic_gates.full: P1-P5 stressed net >0, PF >=1.05 and net/DD >=1.25.
economic_gates.retention_limit: At most one exact FIXED_RFS_NEWSY_MONTH_US500_CASH_SESSION_DIRECTION information seed.
economic_gates.strong_null: P1 net <=0, no more than one positive confirmation period, prelatest net <=0 and full net <=0.
economic_gates.ambiguous: Any complete valid outcome that is neither pass nor strong null retains no seed.
